name: Dual Contouring Feature Point Iterative Projection
definition: An iterative method to find a feature point (vertex) inside a voxel cell by projecting a point onto planes defined by edge midpoints and normals, minimizing the distance to these planes.
summary: Dual Contouring Feature Point Iterative Projection is a fast heuristic that computes feature points by iteratively projecting onto edge-intersection planes, avoiding the computational cost of solving least-squares systems.
